title: Product truth before redesign
question: Night-network is discarded. Luxury editorial + minimalist corporate is the pinned visual brief — adapted for LIRN/TORNS, not generic consulting. Pick the product package that locks CTA, evidence, and scope.

options.label: Contacto + prueba honesta
options.thesis: Sell to real operators. Primary CTA: Hablemos / Contacto. Cut logos, metrics, testimonials, cases, and team until real. Show mission, vision, problem, TORNS mechanism, and prototype capabilities only. Scope: LIRN home + /torns + tro-frontend family restyle.
options.viewport: Editorial hero → mission/vision → problem → TORNS product path → closing conversation. No fake trust bar.
options.risk: Needs a real contact path (mailto or form) when you have it.

options.label: TORNS primero
options.thesis: Primary action is understand TORNS (/torns). Contact is secondary in footer. Same honest evidence rule. Same three-surface scope.
options.viewport: LIRN introduces company + points to TORNS; TORNS carries depth; contact stays quiet.
options.risk: Less ‘executive consultation’ than the instructivo template.

options.label: Contacto + shells pendientes
options.thesis: Contact CTA plus instructivo section shells (metrics, cases, testimonials) clearly marked [PENDIENTE]. Same three-surface scope.
options.viewport: Fuller consulting skeleton with labeled gaps for you to fill.
options.risk: Weak labels can be misread as real claims.
